description: Business terms and where their figures come from. When a question uses a term (or one of its aliases), its definition is added to the router and database-planner prompts so a term is never guessed from the nearest-sounding column. Edit freely; matching is whole-word and case-insensitive (see app/services/business_glossary.py).

terms.meaning: Commission paid to the sourcing agent / DSA, as a % of the disbursed amount, by product and by the agent's quarterly disbursement-volume slab.
terms.source: The agent commission slab sheet (uploaded spreadsheet / file). The database agents.commission_rate is only each agent's flat contracted rate.
terms.not: Not loan_products.processing_fee_pct - a processing fee is income the lender earns from the borrower, never a cost.

terms.meaning: Upfront fee charged to the borrower, as a % of the loan amount (loan_products.processing_fee_pct; posted in transactions_ledger as 'Processing Fee').
terms.not: It is income to the lender, not a cost of acquiring the loan.

terms.meaning: The loan's interest rate minus the benchmark lending rate for the same year (percentage points). Average the loan rates per group first; never add rates up.
terms.source: Loan rate: database loans.interest_rate. Benchmark: the external lending-rate API (World Bank indicator FR.INR.LEND for India), matched on disbursement year.

terms.meaning: India's average bank lending interest rate for a year, in %.
terms.source: External API (World Bank FR.INR.LEND). Values exist up to 2022; later years are null.
terms.not: Not a column in the loan database.

terms.meaning: Amount set aside against expected loss on a loan, as a % of outstanding principal, driven by its DPD bucket / asset classification.
terms.source: Policy %: the IRACP norms document (uploaded file). Applied % per loan snapshot: database npa_classification.provisioning_pct / provisioning_amount.

terms.meaning: Share of loans that are non-performing: loans with npa_flag = true (DPD > 90), divided by all loans in the group. Compute as an average of a 1/0 flag, not a sum.
terms.source: Database loans.npa_flag (or npa_classification for a given as_of_date).
